name: Wittenborg University
description: Wittenborg University of Applied Sciences is a vibrant, double-accredited business school based in Apeldoorn. Wittenborg was founded in 1987. Dutch universities are well-known for their high academic standards and high-quality education. Wittenborg intends to uphold these criteria throughout its programs. It is one of the few 100% English-speaking higher education schools in the Netherlands, and its 1000+ students and staff come from over 100 different countries, making it the Netherlands' most international private University of applied sciences and business school. The school also maintains a thriving study location in Amsterdam, emphasizing Entrepreneurship. Wittenborg's undergraduate and master's programs are internationally recognized and accredited in Europe. It is ranked #176-200 in QS International Trade Ranking 2023. Moreover, Wittenborg University places a high value on leading students to successful jobs. The university's comprehensive career services and support systems are designed to help students find jobs, secure internships, and advance their careers. Students are better equipped with this crucial help to improve their employability and confidently launch their professions after graduation.
